wine.title: Wine
wine.intro: Three characters, one approach: minimal intervention, maximum terroir.

items.name: Pomegranate Ruby
items.desc: Deep, velvety, with a long finish. Aged in oak barrels for 18 months.

items.name: Golden Dawn
items.desc: Fresh and bright, with a mineral note. Perfect with seafood and warm evenings.

items.name: Morning Dew
items.desc: Light and lively by nature. The best choice for a celebration or a picnic.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: It all began with a small plot of land and a big dream: to make wine we are proud of and love to share. We grew up among the vines and we know that good grapes are born where they are loved.
story.p2: Today we still harvest by hand, carefully select every cluster and give each wine the time it needs to mature. No rush, only patience, hard work and a little bit of magic.

timeline.title: The first vine
timeline.text: We planted our first rows on a slope inherited from our grandfather.

timeline.title: The first barrel
timeline.text: We released our first batch and bottled it for friends and family.

timeline.title: Our own winery
timeline.text: We built a cellar and opened our doors to the first guests.

timeline.title: Wine with character
timeline.text: We craft three collections and look forward to welcoming you for a tasting.
